Frequently Asked Questions
I genuinely don't have time. How short are the workouts?

Most workouts in the challenge are under 30 minutes. Several are closer to 20. They're designed to fit into the gaps in your day — after the kids are in bed, during nap time, or first thing in the morning before the house wakes up. No commute, no gym bag, no setup. Just you and your phone.
I've tried Weight Watchers and other programmes before and they didn't work long-term. Why would this be any different?

Most programmes fail busy mums because they're not built for busy mum life. They assume you have time to track every meal, prep separate food, or get to a gym three times a week. This challenge works around your actual schedule — family meals, unpredictable days, and all. The goal isn't perfection. It's a simple routine you can actually keep going.
Do I need any equipment or a gym membership?
No gym, no equipment required. Everything in the challenge is designed to be done at home. If you have a mat and a small space, you have everything you need.
What happens after the 30 days? Is there a catch?

The challenge is completely free. At the end of 30 days, if you've enjoyed it and want to keep going with more structured coaching from Tom, that option is there. But there's no pressure, no automatic billing, and no catch. You sign up, you do the challenge, you see how you feel.
